Mathematics BSc (Hons) at University of Bath

What University of Bath asks of applicants to Mathematics BSc (Hons) for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

SAT / ACT

Not verified: Bath’s 2027 Mathematics page (https://www.bath.ac.uk/courses/undergraduate-2027/mathematical-sciences/bsc-mathematics/) says its typical Advanced Placement requirements for this course are under review and will be published soon, and states nothing about SAT/ACT for US-diploma applicants — check the official page.

Not verified
English language
  • Bath English language Category C
  • IELTS 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in all components
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 90 overall with a minimum 21 in all components (taken up to 21 Jan 2026)
    • 4.5 overall with a minimum 4.0 in all components (taken after 21 Jan 2026)
  • PTE Academic 62 with no less than 59 in any element (PTE Academic Online not accepted); Cambridge CPE/CAE 180 with no less than 169 in all elements
  • Needed if you do not meet Bath’s GCSE English requirement
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry)
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Exception: in exceptional cases an applicant with only AS-level Further Mathematics may need STEP (grade 2 in any STEP, or Merit in the AEA, appears in that alternative offer).

Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry)
Subject prerequisites
  • Required:
    • Mathematics and Further Mathematics (A level; AS Further Mathematics only in exceptional cases)
    • HL Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches (IB)
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry)
A-Level requirements
Grades
A*A*A
Required subjects
Mathematics, Further Mathematics
Details
A*A*A in three A levels including A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics. Alternative offers: A*AA or A*A*B (A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics) plus a recognised extra; in exceptional cases A*A*A including A* in Mathematics plus A in AS Further Mathematics plus grade 2 in any STEP or Merit in the AEA.
Contextual offer
A*AB including A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics for eligible contextual applicants (applied automatically)
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry)
IB requirements
Overall score
36 points
Required subjects
Mathematics, Mathematics at Higher Level
Higher Level
Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
Details
36 points and either 7,7,6 at HL incl 6 in Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches, or 7,6,6 / 7,7,5 at HL incl 7 in Maths AA — AA required at HL; Applications & Interpretation not considered
Verified19 Oct 2026Bath: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry)
Other qualifications

  • SAT Subject Tests are not accepted for direct entry

Official (2027 entry): no AP requirement is published for this course yet — Bath says it is under review. Contact admissions@bath.ac.uk.

Other requirements
